problem_text:
A logistics company must coordinate 10 delivery trucks to transport packages through 10 different distribution centers.

Each truck carries a shipment that must pass through centers in a specific order, represented as pairs (Center, Handling time), where each pair specifies the distribution center where the package must be processed and the amount of time required for handling. The sequence of pairs indicates the mandatory order in which the centers must be visited.

Shipment details:
* S1 must follow the route: (C7, 2) → (C9, 8) → (C3, 8) → (C6, 1) → (C4, 4) → (C10, 9) → (C8, 1) → (C1, 2) → (C2, 7) → (C5, 2)
* S2 must follow the route: (C7, 3) → (C3, 10) → (C8, 3) → (C5, 8) → (C10, 3) → (C9, 8) → (C4, 4) → (C1, 1) → (C6, 9) → (C2, 1)
* S3 must follow the route: (C9, 10) → (C8, 1) → (C10, 8) → (C4, 8) → (C3, 8) → (C7, 5) → (C6, 7) → (C5, 4) → (C1, 1) → (C2, 1)
* S4 must follow the route: (C6, 4) → (C7, 3) → (C8, 5) → (C2, 9) → (C5, 9) → (C10, 3) → (C1, 7) → (C3, 10) → (C4, 2) → (C9, 5)
* S5 must follow the route: (C7, 2) → (C4, 5) → (C2, 7) → (C5, 6) → (C3, 6) → (C9, 7) → (C8, 6) → (C6, 7) → (C10, 5) → (C1, 1)
* S6 must follow the route: (C4, 10) → (C8, 7) → (C6, 4) → (C2, 7) → (C1, 6) → (C3, 2) → (C9, 1) → (C7, 4) → (C5, 5) → (C10, 2)
* S7 must follow the route: (C4, 3) → (C5, 4) → (C2, 9) → (C8, 8) → (C7, 1) → (C6, 3) → (C10, 8) → (C3, 10) → (C9, 2) → (C1, 1)
* S8 must follow the route: (C5, 3) → (C8, 3) → (C10, 6) → (C2, 7) → (C9, 5) → (C6, 6) → (C7, 8) → (C3, 8) → (C4, 7) → (C1, 3)
* S9 must follow the route: (C10, 6) → (C8, 1) → (C4, 6) → (C3, 8) → (C9, 6) → (C6, 8) → (C5, 2) → (C1, 2) → (C2, 9) → (C7, 5)
* S10 must follow the route: (C5, 9) → (C7, 1) → (C6, 7) → (C8, 9) → (C9, 6) → (C4, 1) → (C1, 6) → (C2, 1) → (C3, 10) → (C10, 8)

Each package must be processed continuously once it starts at a center and cannot be interrupted, and each distribution center can only handle one package at a time. The objective is to determine the processing schedule for all packages at the distribution centers so that the total completion time for all shipments is minimized.
